digest.component_or_area: code-review gate batch assembly and runner
propositions: Project-scoped LLM criteria are not fanned into Round A/B batch requests because CodeReviewBatchRunner iterates only static YAML-injected built-in criteria and lacks logical criterion id attribution.

Active project criteria with exec:LLM routing must be assembled at gate_dispatch construction time and passed to the runner, which combines them with req.criteria only when step_id==round_a to ensure once-per-review execution without double-run in round_b.

Findings emitted by project criteria entries must preserve model tags and append the logical criterion_id; prompt resolution errors must raise a located LLMError naming the criterion and expected path.
The runner instance must remain stateless and deterministic across retries and replays, using no mutable seen-set and no cross-run state.
